Family Constructor

Source: R/family.R
dbn_make_family.Rd

Builds a dbn_family structure holding all family-specific callbacks

Usage

dbn_make_family(
  name,
  draw_latent,
  ffbs_wrapper,
  loglik,
  linkinv,
  rgen_obs,
  init_pars = list()
)

Arguments

name

Family name string

draw_latent

Latent Z sampler

ffbs_wrapper

FFBS dispatch wrapper

loglik

Log-likelihood function

linkinv

Inverse link function

rgen_obs

Observation generator

init_pars

Initial parameter list

Value

A dbn_family object
